title: 02. Ingestion & Chunking: Document Versioning and Incremental Updates
summary: In production RAG systems, documents are living artifacts — policies get updated, contracts are amended, knowledge bases evolve.

sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: In production RAG systems, documents are living artifacts — policies get updated, contracts are amended, knowledge bases evolve. Without proper versioning, a RAG system will return outdated information with the same confidence as current information, causing dangerous errors (outdated drug dosages, superseded legal clauses, old pricing). Document versioning requires tracking each document's version in metadata, detecting when a new version is uploaded, atomically replacing the old vectors, and optionally maintaining version history for temporal queries ("What did the policy say in January?").

sections.title: ② Key Code
sections.body:
```python
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional
import hashlib
from qdrant_client import QdrantClient
from qdrant_client.models import Filter, FieldCondition, MatchValue

@dataclass
class DocumentVersion:
    doc_id: str
    version: str
    content_hash: str
    indexed_at: str
    is_current: bool = True

class VersionedDocumentStore:
    """Manages versioned documents in vector store."""
    
    def __init__(self, qdrant: QdrantClient, collection: str):
        self.qdrant = qdrant
        self.collection = collection
    
    def get_current_version(self, doc_id: str) -> Optional[DocumentVersion]:
        """Get metadata of currently indexed version."""
        results, _ = self.qdrant.scroll(
            collection_name=self.collection,
            scroll_filter=Filter(must=[
                FieldCondition(key="doc_id", match=MatchValue(value=doc_id)),
                FieldCondition(key="is_current", match=MatchValue(value=True)),
            ]),
            limit=1,
            with_payload=True
        )
        
        if results:
            payload = results[0].payload
            return DocumentVersion(
                doc_id=payload["doc_id"],
                version=payload.get("version", "unknown"),
                content_hash=payload.get("content_hash", ""),
                indexed_at=payload.get("indexed_at", ""),
            )
        return None
    
    async def upsert_version(
        self,
        doc_id: str,
        new_content: str,
        new_version: str,
        metadata: dict,
        embedder,
        splitter,
        keep_history: bool = False
    ) -> dict:
        """Atomically replace current version, optionally archiving old."""
        new_hash = hashlib.sha256(new_content.encode()).hexdigest()
        current = self.get_current_version(doc_id)
        
        if current and current.content_hash == new_hash:
            return {"status": "unchanged", "doc_id": doc_id, "version": new_version}
        
        if keep_history and current:
            # Archive old version: mark is_current=False
            self.qdrant.set_payload(
                collection_name=self.collection,
                payload={"is_current": False},
                points=Filter(must=[
                    FieldCondition(key="doc_id", match=MatchValue(value=doc_id)),
                    FieldCondition(key="is_current", match=MatchValue(value=True)),
                ])
            )
        else:
            # Delete old vectors entirely
            self.qdrant.delete(
                collection_name=self.collection,
                points_selector=Filter(must=[
                    FieldCondition(key="doc_id", match=MatchValue(value=doc_id))
                ])
            )
        
        # Chunk and embed new version
        from langchain_core.documents import Document as LCDocument
        lc_doc = LCDocument(page_content=new_content, metadata=metadata)
        chunks = splitter.split_documents([lc_doc])
        texts = [c.page_content for c in chunks]
        embeddings = await embedder.aembed_documents(texts)
        
        # Upsert new version
        import uuid
        from qdrant_client.models import PointStruct
        
        points = [
            PointStruct(
                id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
                vector=emb,
                payload={
                    **chunks[i].metadata,
                    "text": texts[i],
                    "doc_id": doc_id,
                    "version": new_version,
                    "content_hash": new_hash,
                    "indexed_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
                    "is_current": True,
                    "previous_version": current.version if current else None
                }
            )
            for i, emb in enumerate(embeddings)
        ]
        
        self.qdrant.upsert(collection_name=self.collection, points=points)
        
        return {
            "status": "updated",
            "doc_id": doc_id,
            "old_version": current.version if current else None,
            "new_version": new_version,
            "chunks_indexed": len(chunks)
        }
    
    def retrieve_at_version(self, doc_id: str, version: str, query_vector: list, top_k: int = 3):
        """Retrieve chunks from a specific historical version (requires keep_history=True)."""
        return self.qdrant.search(
            collection_name=self.collection,
            query_vector=query_vector,
            limit=top_k,
            query_filter=Filter(must=[
                FieldCondition(key="doc_id", match=MatchValue(value=doc_id)),
                FieldCondition(key="version", match=MatchValue(value=version)),
            ])
        )
```

sections.title: ④ Visual Explanation
sections.body:
```
DOCUMENT VERSIONING FLOW
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

VERSION LIFECYCLE:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Time ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────▶

Jan 1: policy_v1.0 indexed
  Vectors: [chunk-a1, chunk-a2, chunk-a3]  is_current=True

Mar 15: policy_v2.0 uploaded (new version)
  │
  ▼ Hash check: content changed
  │
  ├─ keep_history=False: DELETE all v1.0 vectors
  │   Index: [chunk-b1, chunk-b2]  is_current=True (v2.0)
  │
  └─ keep_history=True: ARCHIVE v1.0 (is_current=False)
      Index: 
        [chunk-a1, chunk-a2, chunk-a3]  is_current=False, version="1.0"
        [chunk-b1, chunk-b2]            is_current=True,  version="2.0"

QUERY ROUTING:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
"What is the refund policy?"
         │
         ▼ Filter: is_current=True
  Returns v2.0 chunks ← CORRECT (current policy)

"What was the refund policy in January?"  (temporal query)
         │
         ▼ Filter: version="1.0"
  Returns v1.0 chunks ← HISTORICAL (audit use case)

STALENESS DETECTION:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Monitoring job runs hourly:
  For each doc_id in source_manifest:
    If source_hash != indexed_hash:
      Alert: "doc_id XYZ needs re-indexing"
      Trigger: incremental_update()
```
